weakness: Integrator remote access to the BAS through an always-on tool; not authorized per session; no documented restrictions
source: P07 (AC-17 objectives); P01 R-001; P03 G-005
remediation_plan: Remove the always-on tool; integrator access only through a remote access gateway with named accounts and per-session approval
milestones: 2026-09-15 tool disabled except during approved sessions (interim); 2026-10-31 gateway live and tool uninstalled
resources_required: $14K per year gateway service; integrator labor

weakness: Nonlocal maintenance not approved, monitored, strongly authenticated, recorded, or terminated
remediation_plan: Gateway sessions approved by a chief engineer; session recording kept 1 year; automatic session end; maintenance log
milestones: 2026-10-31 with POAM-001; 2026-11-30 first monthly review of session records

weakness: No MFA for BAS administration or integrator remote access
remediation_plan: MFA enforced at the remote access gateway for all BAS and integrator access; BAS local logins only from the gateway or the engineering console

weakness: BAS backups weekly only; same account and region; not immutable; controller programs and graphics held only by the integrator
source: P07 (CP-9 objectives); P01 R-002; P03 G-025; P04 finding 1
remediation_plan: Daily BAS server backup to a separate backup account with immutable retention in a second region; integrator delivers controller programs and graphics after every change
milestones: 2026-10-15 design approved; 2026-11-30 backups migrated; 2026-12-31 full set of controller programs and graphics received
resources_required: $7K per year cloud cost; MSP and integrator labor

weakness: No restore or contingency test has ever been performed
remediation_plan: Quarterly restore tests of the BAS server and a sample of controllers; annual contingency plan tabletop
milestones: 2026-11-15 first BAS restore test; 2027-03-31 first contingency plan exercise
resources_required: Staff time; integrator labor for controller reload test

weakness: No internal boundary between corporate and OT at Properties B and C; boundaries not monitored
source: P07 (SC-7 objectives); P01 R-003; P03 G-019
remediation_plan: OT zones for BAS, access control, and video at each property per SP 800-82 Rev. 3; firewall logs to the central log service
milestones: 2026-12-31 Property B zones live; 2027-03-31 Property C zones live and monitored

weakness: Corporate network reaches the BAS server on all ports at Property A; no flow control at Properties B and C
remediation_plan: Deny-by-default conduits: only the historian feed, the platform cloud connections, and gateway sessions allowed
milestones: 2026-11-30 Property A rules tightened; 2027-03-31 all properties with POAM-006

weakness: No contingency plan or manual operating procedures for HVAC and doors
source: P07 (CP-2 objectives); P01 R-021 R-018; P03 G-034
remediation_plan: Contingency plan from the BIA (P05) with manual operating procedures for each property, contact lists, and restart sequences
milestones: 2026-10-31 draft; 2026-12-31 approved and distributed to chief engineers and the console

weakness: Default passwords on 12 field controllers and 2 NVRs; weak and unchanged OT passwords in a plaintext spreadsheet
source: P07 (IA-5 objectives; new finding IA-05e.); P01 R-007
remediation_plan: Change all defaults; password manager for OT local accounts; commissioning checklist
milestones: 2026-09-30 defaults changed; 2026-11-30 OT passwords moved to the password manager and spreadsheet deleted

weakness: Shared BAS engineer, integrator, and guard viewing accounts
remediation_plan: Named guard accounts in the platform; named BAS accounts for each engineer and integrator technician
milestones: 2026-10-31 named guard accounts; 2026-12-31 named BAS accounts and shared account disabled

weakness: Late disabling; no reviews; stale tenant badges; shared account password never changed
remediation_plan: Same-day disable from the HR ticket; quarterly account and badge reviews; 60-day badge auto-suspend; quarterly tenant roster attestation
milestones: 2026-10-31 same-day process live; 2026-12-31 first tenant attestation and stale badge purge

weakness: All 9 security staff are full platform administrators
remediation_plan: Two named administrators; operator roles for console staff; quarterly review

weakness: No OT asset inventory; integrator lists incomplete
source: P07 (CM-8 objectives); P01 R-034; P03 G-006
remediation_plan: Build the OT inventory with the integrators (device, firmware, address, location, owner); quarterly update
milestones: 2026-11-15 Property A; 2026-12-31 all properties

weakness: No change control for BAS programs, OT networks, or vendor-enabled features
remediation_plan: Change request with backup-before-change and chief engineer approval; BAS audit trail enabled; COO approval for new analytics features
milestones: 2026-10-31 procedure approved; 2026-12-31 in use for all integrator work

weakness: No review of firewall, remote access, BAS, or platform administrator logs
remediation_plan: MSP log service with 1-year retention; weekly review; OT alert rules
milestones: 2026-11-30 contract; 2027-01-31 all sources connected and weekly review started

weakness: BAS server OS unsupported and unpatched; OT firmware not tracked or tested
remediation_plan: Upgrade BAS server OS and BAS software; quarterly firmware review for NVRs and controllers with test-before-install
milestones: 2026-11-30 NVR firmware current; 2027-03-31 BAS upgrade complete

weakness: No vulnerability monitoring of OT or internal networks; no remediation timeframes
remediation_plan: Quarterly external scans; quarterly authenticated scans of corporate systems; passive OT discovery (no active scans of controllers); remediation timeframes
milestones: 2026-10-31 first quarterly external scan; 2026-11-30 first internal scan; 2027-03-31 passive OT discovery
resources_required: MSP scanning included in contract; $3K passive discovery

weakness: No security requirements or monitoring for integrators, MSP, guard, and visitor management vendors
source: P07 (SA-9 objectives); P01 R-015 R-016 R-012; P03 G-004
remediation_plan: Security addendum (named accounts, MFA, 24-hour incident notice, vulnerability notice); annual review; platform SOC 2 review (P09)
milestones: 2026-08-20 platform SOC 2 reviewed; 2026-12-31 addendum signed by both integrators and the MSP

weakness: OT incident handling not defined or practiced
source: P07 (IR-4 objectives); P01 R-021; P03 G-003
remediation_plan: Adopt POL-03 and the P08 runbook; forensic retainer through the insurer panel; tabletop with engineering and console staff
milestones: 2026-08-31 runbook approved; 2026-11-30 tabletop

weakness: No reporting time or published incident line; no defined recipients
remediation_plan: Publish the incident line; 1-hour reporting rule (POL-03 4.2); notification matrix (P08)
milestones: 2026-08-31 matrix approved; 2026-10-31 incident line published and included in training

weakness: Annual video only; no privacy content, phishing exercises, or reminders
source: P07 (AT-2 objectives); P01 R-010; P03 G-020
remediation_plan: Quarterly phishing exercises; monthly reminders; OT role training for engineers and console operators; card-handling module
milestones: 2026-10-31 first phishing exercise; 2026-12-31 OT role training complete

weakness: Paper card data never destroyed; NVR drives returned unwiped; no destruction records
remediation_plan: Shred the booking binder; wipe or keep failed NVR drives (integrator swap without drive return); certified destruction vendor
milestones: 2026-09-30 booking binder shredded by the Controller; 2026-12-31 destruction vendor and drive-retention clause in place
